package.name: robotops_trace_semconv
package.description: RobotOps Trace robotics semantic conventions v0 (ROB-430). Header-only C++ definitions plus a mirrored Python module of the attribute keys shared by every RobotOps trace integration (and the rclcpp/rclpy SDK cores). Two namespaces: robot.* portable concept keys and ros.* ROS-mapping keys, plus the service.name/robot.id resource attributes. This is the authoritative source of truth and the lockstep contract that keeps span attributes consistent across frameworks.
